items.title: Article: Server-Side DPoP and Token Exchange in Spring Security 7
items.blurb: Spring Authorization Server now lives inside Spring Security 7 under the same Maven coordinates, so the upgrade is a version bump.

items.title: GitLab warns of max severity code execution vulnerability
items.blurb: GitLab warned users today to immediately patch a maximum-severity vulnerability in the CI/CD Regular Expression Compiler that could let remote attackers run arbitrary code on targeted instances.
